description: Search the Merchinary product documentation to learn how to do something or whether a capability exists. Covers the Bulk Product Editor and Image Editor Shopify apps (getting started, core features, field guides, scheduling, troubleshooting, and more). Returns ranked pages with a snippet and URL; follow up with read_doc for the full how-to. Indexed products: bulk-product-editor, image-editor.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–25, default 5).

product.description: Optional product filter. One of the indexed products, e.g. "bulk-product-editor" or "image-editor".

query.description: What you want to do or find, e.g. "bulk edit product tags" or "schedule a price change".

name: search_docs
title: Search Merchinary docs
